sources.title: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future

cards.summary: Last year, Google filed a patent for a system called My Channel that's designed to create feeds filled with personalized, AI-generated videos and advertisements based on information the company knows about its users.
